title: Sepang International Circuit
sub: A Hermann Tilke design opened in 1999, returning to the Formula 1 calendar in October 2026 after a nine-year absence to host the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
_state: MINIMAL — SOURCED FIELDS ONLY (added 2026-08-01). Length, first Grand Prix (1999) and the lap record are from formula1.com/en/racing/2026/bahrain; the tz is unambiguous (Malaysia observes a single zone). EVERYTHING ELSE IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT: no turn count, no laps, no lat/lng, no sectors, no corners, no DRS zones, no tyre allocation, no strategy, no geo. Per the store canon rule, an unsourced value is left out rather than invented — this app has already been burned once by a fabricated dataset (Decision Log W1, the DETAIL map). `report` is FALSE, so the grid card is disabled and no breakdown route opens until the layout data is genuinely dug.
